headline: <cite index="1-3">Acquisition of approximately one million sq ft Grade A office park in Pune</cite>
sum: EAAA's Rental Yield Plus fund acquired a 95%-occupied Pune office park through its flagship commercial real estate fund. The transaction expanded RYP's portfolio to 5.2 million sq ft, including nearly one million sq ft under binding contracts.
implication: <cite index="1-6,1-7">The deal marks RYP's fifth investment and first acquisition in Maharashtra, broadening the fund's presence beyond Bengaluru and Gurugram into Pune, one of India's established commercial property markets.</cite> The structuring demonstrates EAAA's deployment of AIF (Category I/II) platform as institutional-grade office yield vehicle.
detail: <cite index="1-8">The asset is situated within a prominent office corridor and is currently 95% occupied by a diversified group of marquee tenants.</cite> <cite index="1-10,1-11">EAAA operates an integrated commercial property platform spanning acquisitions, asset enhancement, active management and long-term value creation; the Pune deal strengthens its position in India's institutional office property segment.</cite> <cite index="39-1">EAAA did not disclose the acquisition cost.</cite> <cite index="48-9,48-10">Since its launch in 2023, Rental Yield Plus has built a portfolio comprising premium office assets leased to leading corporate tenants under long-term agreements, with previous acquisitions including Phase 1 of International Tech Park Gurgaon, MFAR Manyata Greenheart Tech Park in Bengaluru, Embassy Office Parks and SP Infocity.</cite>

framework.note: Governs registration and operation of Rental Yield Plus as Category I/II AIF; EAAA is registered portfolio manager (INP000008260)
